setup.select_crew.required: Select exactly four astronauts to start.

tutorial.first_night.title: Night is coming
tutorial.first_night.body: Solar generation falls at night. Watch power and battery reserves.
tutorial.lab.title: Research begins here
tutorial.lab.body: Build a Laboratory to research new technology.
tutorial.solar.title: Reliable power
tutorial.solar.body: Research and build Solar Panels, then store energy in Batteries.
tutorial.scan.title: Search from orbit
tutorial.scan.body: Scan an adjacent sector to reveal aquifers and mineable ground.
tutorial.rocket.title: Prepare the rocket
tutorial.rocket.body: Choose cargo within the mass limit, then reserve a clear 8×8 landing zone.
tutorial.radiation.title: Radiation warning
tutorial.radiation.body: Keep the crew in the Base during the flare unless an outside emergency is worth the dose.
dialogue.tutorial_skipped: Tutorial skipped. You can re-enable it in Settings.
science.source.donki.explanation: NASA DONKI records solar activity such as flares and energetic particles. This game uses selected archived events to explain radiation warnings.
science.source.donki.limit: An archived event helps explain risk, but it is not a live Mars forecast and does not directly set health outcomes.
science.source.radlab.explanation: NASA's RadLab provides radiation measurements from instruments in space. It helps explain what a radiation dose means.
science.source.radlab.limit: These measurements are not Mars-surface readings, so the game does not treat them as a Mars dose.
science.source.mars_trek.explanation: NASA Mars Trek shares maps and terrain data from Mars missions. It inspires the outpost's terrain context.
science.source.mars_trek.limit: The game map is a simplified learning map, not a surveyed real landing site.
ambient.thought.1: The red horizon makes Earth feel very far away.
ambient.thought.2: A quiet greenhouse is the closest thing to a garden on Mars.
ambient.science.1: Mars has a thin atmosphere, so it cannot retain heat as well as Earth.
ambient.science.2: Martian regolith is useful for shielding, but it is not soil for crops.
result.defeat: All astronauts have died. Mission failed.
